title: Hyp Genus2 Height Perf
objective: Integrate a production modular/local genus-2 Kummer height path and benchmark accuracy-matched heights, pairings, and regulators against Magma.

handoff.summary: Added a certified bounded-state modular/dyadic genus-2 canonical-height path with source-transparent arbitrary-Integer finite and archimedean recurrences, identical dynamic fallbacks, a specialized exact-small-step oracle, reusable model/point/pairing contexts, finite and archimedean tail certificates, and propagated pairing/regulator accuracy. Corrected the non-monic binary-sextic discriminant factor, bound every proof and cache artifact to the exact model, and added adversarial regressions plus a resident Magma benchmark at 64, 128, and 256 target bits. Automatic-bound authentication and the canonical/pairing caches now live exclusively in non-exported closure state: every hit replays the full live model, point, algorithm, accuracy, and freshly specialized Flynn tables. Cache payloads contain only primitive integer endpoint pairs and encoded diagnostic data, and every egress reconstructs a fresh sealed result. Public bound copies do not consume the bounded theorem-source registry; an evicted source is safely rederived from the captured theorem implementation. Module-token and verifier rebinding, direct context injection, endpoint and object-level poison, exact/local fake-bound injection, cross-parameter/model/point reuse, dual-table-alias mutation, and 600-copy proof liveness are regression tested. Independent review passed the final proof/accessor boundary, and the quiet accuracy-matched 64-bit receipt passes the Phase-7 <=2x Magma gate for both object-cold and authenticated warm heights.
risks: The production local path currently covers primitive integral classical odd-degree quintics with h=0; generalized, rational-coefficient, and other models retain the guarded exact path.

Legacy Magma 2.18-5 prints a stable arbitrary-looking tail but agrees with the exact Kummer recurrence only through about 100 bits. The benchmark conservatively treats only its 96-bit prefix as an independent oracle; wider Sage.js certificates are theorem-backed and checked against the exact recurrence.

The reviewed implementation sequence depends on the production-kernel registry, package routing, and adjusted lazy budget integrated at root commit 71cdb818. Root's focused integration, strict, and architecture checks passed before the quiet receipt; cherry-picking only the receipt commit onto a pre-integration tree is insufficient.
Focused cross-platform runtime receipts remain to be collected on Windows x64, Linux arm64, and macOS arm64; the implementation is ordinary Python and introduces no native dependency.

The final quiet bench-1 acceptance at integrated commit 71cdb818 measured Sage.js 64/128/256-bit object-cold latency 365.08/380.64/782.15 ms and authenticated warm latency 12.44/10.88/11.53 ms, with achieved widths 67/131/259 and both recurrences native. Magma 2.18-5 measured 190/20/20 ms cold and 8.571/12.857/24.286 ms warm, but only its 64-bit row is accuracy-matched; its 128/256-bit output has only 96 demonstrated stable bits. The accuracy-matched 64-bit ratios are 1.92x cold and 1.45x warm, so the Phase-7 <=2x gate passes. Reused rank-2 Sage.js pairing/regulator measured 20.38/27.54 ms versus Magma 42.857/40 ms; Sage.js wins the reused workload, while its 855.43 ms cold pairing remains 17.1x Magma's 50 ms and is the clear remaining envelope.
next_steps: Move immutable Flynn duplication tables and their generic evaluator into a neutral genus2_kummer_formulas module so both public prime-field Kummer arithmetic and the height layer depend downward without duplication.
When integrating automatic selection changes, preserve legacy resource-guard coverage by making the corresponding test request algorithm='exact' explicitly.
Collect focused runtime receipts on windows, bench-arm, and m1, then optimize only measured architecture-specific regressions.

Optimize rank-2 object-cold pairing construction, which remains 17.1x Magma despite Sage.js winning the authenticated reused pairing/regulator workloads. Preserve the reviewed closure-backed proof boundary and the fresh-result egress contract while profiling the three new canonical heights and polarization assembly. Obtain a modern independent 128/256-bit competitor only if it demonstrates those target accuracies.
